data_category.label: Data Categories
data_category.subtitle: What kind of data it is

nodes.name: System Data
nodes.description: Data unique to, and under control of the system.

nodes.name: Authentication Data
nodes.description: Data used to manage access to the system.

nodes.name: Operations Data
nodes.description: Data used for system operations.

nodes.name: User Data
nodes.description: Data related to the user of the system, either provided directly or derived based on their usage.

nodes.name: Account Information
nodes.description: Account creation or registration information.

nodes.name: Authorization Information
nodes.description: Scope of permissions and access to a system.

nodes.name: Observed Behavior
nodes.description: Behavioral data about the subject.

nodes.name: Biometric Data
nodes.description: Encoded characteristics provided by a user.

nodes.name: Children's Data
nodes.description: Data relating to children.

nodes.name: Contact Data
nodes.description: Contact data collected about a user.

nodes.name: User Content
nodes.description: Content related to, or created by the subject.

nodes.name: Demographic Data
nodes.description: Demographic data about a user.

nodes.name: Location Data
nodes.description: Records of the location of a user.

nodes.name: Device Data
nodes.description: Data related to a user's device, configuration and setting.

nodes.name: Payment Data
nodes.description: Payment data related to user.

nodes.name: Social Data
nodes.description: Social activity and interaction data.

nodes.name: Unique ID
nodes.description: Unique identifier for a user assigned through system use.

nodes.name: Telemetry Data
nodes.description: User identifiable measurement data from system sensors and monitoring.

nodes.name: User Sensor Data
nodes.description: Measurement data about a user's environment through system use.

nodes.name: Workplace
nodes.description: Organization of employment.

nodes.name: Sensor Data
nodes.description: Measurement data from sensors and monitoring systems.

nodes.name: Financial Data
nodes.description: Payment data and financial history.

nodes.name: Government ID
nodes.description: State provided identification data.

nodes.name: Health and Medical Data
nodes.description: Health records or individual's personal medical information.

nodes.name: Name
nodes.description: User's real name.

nodes.name: Criminal History
nodes.description: Criminal records or information about the data subject.

nodes.name: Privacy Preferences
nodes.description: Privacy preferences or settings set by the subject.

nodes.name: Job Title
nodes.description: Professional data.

nodes.name: Account Settings
nodes.description: Account preferences and settings.

nodes.name: Account Username
nodes.description: Username associated with account.

nodes.name: Account password
nodes.description: Authentication credentials to a system.

nodes.name: Biometric Credentials
nodes.description: Credentials for system authentication.

nodes.name: Password
nodes.description: Password for system authentication.

nodes.name: Browsing History
nodes.description: Content browsing history of a user.

nodes.name: Media Consumption
nodes.description: Content consumption history of the subject.

nodes.name: Purchase History
nodes.description: Purchase history of the subject.

nodes.name: Search History
nodes.description: Search history of the subject.

nodes.name: Fingerprint
nodes.description: Fingerprint encoded data about a subject.

nodes.name: Retina Scan
nodes.description: Retinal data about a subject.

nodes.name: Voice Recording
nodes.description: Voice encoded data about a subject.

nodes.name: Biometric Health Data
nodes.description: Encoded characteristic collected about a user.

nodes.name: User Contact Address
nodes.description: Contact address data collected about a user.

nodes.name: User Contact Email
nodes.description: User's contact email address.

nodes.name: User Contact Phone Number
nodes.description: User's phone number.

nodes.name: User Website
nodes.description: Subject's websites or links to social and personal profiles.

nodes.name: Fax Number
nodes.description: Data Subject's fax number.

nodes.name: Organization
nodes.description: Data Subject's Organization.

nodes.name: User Contact City
nodes.description: User's city level address data.

nodes.name: User Contact Country
nodes.description: User's country level address data.

nodes.name: User Contact Postal Code
nodes.description: User's postal code.

nodes.name: User Contact State
nodes.description: User's state level address data.

nodes.name: User Contact Street
nodes.description: User's street level address data.

nodes.name: Private Content
nodes.description: Private content related to, or created by the subject, not publicly available.

nodes.name: Public Content
nodes.description: Publicly shared Content related to, or created by the subject.

nodes.name: User Image
nodes.description: Photograph or image in which subject is whole or partially recognized.

nodes.name: Age Range
nodes.description: Non specific age or age-range of data subject.

nodes.name: Birth Date
nodes.description: Date of birth of data subject.

nodes.name: Gender
nodes.description: Gender of data subject.

nodes.name: Language
nodes.description: Spoken or written language of subject.

nodes.name: Marital Status
nodes.description: Marital status of data subject.

nodes.name: Political Opinion
nodes.description: Political opinion or belief of data subject.

nodes.name: User Profile Data
nodes.description: Profile or preference information about the data subject.

nodes.name: Race
nodes.description: Race or ethnicity of data subject.

nodes.name: Religion
nodes.description: Religion or religious beliefs of the data subject.

nodes.name: Sexual Orientation
nodes.description: Sexual orientation of data subject.

nodes.name: Device Cookie
nodes.description: Data related to a subject, stored within a cookie.

nodes.name: Cookie ID
nodes.description: Cookie unique identification number.

nodes.name: Device ID
nodes.description: Device unique identification number.

nodes.name: IP Address
nodes.description: Unique identifier related to device connection.

nodes.name: Bank Account Information
nodes.description: Bank account information belonging to the subject.

nodes.name: Credit Card Information
nodes.description: Credit card information belonging to the subject.

nodes.name: Birth Certificate
nodes.description: State issued certificate of birth.

nodes.name: Driver's License Number
nodes.description: State issued driving identification number.

nodes.name: Immigration ID
nodes.description: State issued immigration or residency data.

nodes.name: National Identification Number
nodes.description: State issued personal identification number.

nodes.name: Passport Number
nodes.description: State issued passport data.

nodes.name: Vehicle Registration
nodes.description: State issued license plate or vehicle registration data.

nodes.name: User's Genetic Data
nodes.description: Data about the genetic makeup provided by the subject.

nodes.name: Medical Insurance ID
nodes.description: Health insurance beneficiary number of the subject.

nodes.name: Medical Record ID
nodes.description: Medical record identifiers belonging to a subject.

nodes.name: Imprecise Subject Location
nodes.description: Imprecise location derived from sensors (more than 500M).

nodes.name: Precise Subject Location
nodes.description: Precise location derived from sensors (less than 500M).

nodes.name: First Name
nodes.description: Subject's first name.

nodes.name: Last Name
nodes.description: Subject's last, or family, name.

nodes.name: Pseudonymous User ID
nodes.description: A pseudonymous, or probabilistic identifier generated from other subject or device data belonging to the subject.

data_use.label: Data Uses
data_use.subtitle: What the data is used for

nodes.name: Analytics
nodes.description: Provides analytics for activities such as system and advertising performance reporting, insights and fraud detection.

nodes.name: Analytics for Reporting
nodes.description: Provides analytics for general reporting such as system and advertising performance.

nodes.name: Analytics for Advertising Performance
nodes.description: Provides analytics for reporting of advertising performance.

nodes.name: Analytics for Content Performance
nodes.description: Analytics for reporting on content performance.

nodes.name: Analytics for Insights
nodes.description: Provides analytics for reporting of campaign insights related to advertising and promotion activities.

nodes.name: Analytics for System Activity
nodes.description: Provides analytics for reporting on system activity.

nodes.name: Analytics for System Performance
nodes.description: Provides analytics for reporting on system performance.

nodes.name: Collect
nodes.description: Collects or stores data in order to use it for another purpose which has not yet been expressly defined.

nodes.name: Employment
nodes.description: Processes data for the purpose of recruitment or employment and human resources (HR) related activities.

nodes.name: Employment Recruitment
nodes.description: Processes data of prospective employees for the purpose of recruitment.

nodes.name: Essential
nodes.description: Operates the service or product, including legal obligations, support and basic system operations.

nodes.name: Essential Fraud Detection
nodes.description: Detects possible fraud or misuse of the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Essential Legal Obligation
nodes.description: Provides service to meet a legal or compliance obligation such as consent management.

nodes.name: Essential for Service
nodes.description: Provides the essential product, service, application or system, without which the product/service would not be possible.

nodes.name: Essential Service Authentication
nodes.description: Authenticate users to the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Essential Service Notifications
nodes.description: Sends notifications about the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Essential for Operations
nodes.description: Essential to ensure the operation of the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Essential for Payment Processing
nodes.description: Essential to processes payments for the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Essential for Security
nodes.description: Essential to provide security for the product, service, application or system

nodes.name: Essential for Service Upgrades
nodes.description: Provides timely system upgrade information options.

nodes.name: Essential Email Service Notifications
nodes.description: Sends email notifications about the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Essential SMS Service Notifications
nodes.description: Sends SMS notifications about the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Essential for Operations Support
nodes.description: Provides support for the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Essential for Support Improvement
nodes.description: Essential to optimize and improve support for the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Finance
nodes.description: Enables finance and accounting activities such as audits and tax reporting.

nodes.name: Functional
nodes.description: Used for specific, necessary, and legitimate purposes

nodes.name: Local Data Storage
nodes.description: Stores or accesses information from the device as needed when using a product, service, application, or system

nodes.name: Service
nodes.description: Functions relating to provided services, products, applications or systems.

nodes.name: Improve Service
nodes.description: Improves the specific product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Local Data Storage for Privacy Preferences
nodes.description: Stores or accesses privacy preferences information from the device as needed when using a product, service, application, or system

nodes.name: Marketing
nodes.description: Enables marketing, promotion, advertising and sales activities for the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Advertising, Marketing or Promotion
nodes.description: Advertises or promotes the product, service, application or system and associated services.

nodes.name: Marketing Communications
nodes.description: Uses combined channels to message and market to a customer, user or prospect.

nodes.name: First Party Advertising
nodes.description: Serves advertisements based on first party data collected or derived about the user.

nodes.name: Frequency Capping
nodes.description: Restricts the number of times a specific advertisement is shown to an individual.

nodes.name: Negative Targeting
nodes.description: Enforces rules used to ensure a certain audience or group is not targeted by advertising.

nodes.name: Profiling for Advertising
nodes.description: Creates audience profiles for the purpose of targeted advertising

nodes.name: Essential for Serving Ads
nodes.description: Essential to the delivery of advertising and content.

nodes.name: Third Party Advertising
nodes.description: Serves advertisements based on data within the system or joined with data provided by 3rd parties.

nodes.name: First Party Contextual Advertising
nodes.description: Serves advertisements based on current content being viewed by the user of the system or service.

nodes.name: First Party Personalized Advertising
nodes.description: Targets advertisements based on data collected or derived about the user from use of the system.

nodes.name: Third Party Targeted Advertising
nodes.description: Targets advertisements based on data within the system or joined with data provided by 3rd parties.

nodes.name: Marketing Email Communications
nodes.description: Sends email marketing communications.

nodes.name: Marketing SMS Communications
nodes.description: Sends SMS marketing communications.

nodes.name: Operations
nodes.description: Supports business processes necessary to the organization's operation.

nodes.name: Personalize
nodes.description: Personalizes the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: Content Personalization
nodes.description: Personalizes the content of the product, service, application or system.

nodes.name: System Personalization
nodes.description: Personalizes the system.

nodes.name: Limited Content Personalization
nodes.description: Uses limited data for the purpose of serving content.

nodes.name: Profiling for Personalization
nodes.description: Creates profiles for the purpose of serving content.

nodes.name: Targeted Content Personalization
nodes.description: Uses profiles for the purpose of serving content.

nodes.name: Sales
nodes.description: Supports sales activities such as communications and outreach.

nodes.name: Third Party Sharing
nodes.description: Transfers data to third parties outside of the system or service's scope.

nodes.name: Sharing for Legal Obligation
nodes.description: Shares data for legal obligations, including contracts, applicable laws or regulations.

nodes.name: Train AI System
nodes.description: Trains an AI system or data model for machine learning.

nodes.name: Anonymous User
nodes.description: An individual that is unidentifiable to the systems. Note - This should only be applied to truly anonymous users where there is no risk of re-identification

nodes.name: Citizen Voter
nodes.description: An individual registered to voter with a state or authority.

nodes.name: Commuter
nodes.description: An individual that is traveling or transiting in the context of location tracking.

nodes.name: Consultant
nodes.description: An individual employed in a consultative/temporary capacity by the organization.

nodes.name: Customer
nodes.description: An individual or other organization that purchases goods or services from the organization.

nodes.name: Employee
nodes.description: An individual employed by the organization.

nodes.name: Job Applicant
nodes.description: An individual applying for employment to the organization.

nodes.name: Next of Kin
nodes.description: A relative of any other individual subject where such a relationship is known.

nodes.name: Passenger
nodes.description: An individual traveling on some means of provided transport.

nodes.name: Patient
nodes.description: An individual identified for the purposes of any medical care.

nodes.name: Prospect
nodes.description: An individual or organization to whom an organization is selling goods or services.

nodes.name: Shareholder
nodes.description: An individual or organization that holds equity in the organization.

nodes.name: Supplier/Vendor
nodes.description: An individual or organization that provides services or goods to the organization.

nodes.name: Trainee
nodes.description: An individual undergoing training by the organization.

nodes.name: Visitor
nodes.description: An individual visiting a location.
